result.title: TriNetra: Thermal-Reliability-Guided RGB-Thermal Fusion and Tracking for Surveillance
result.summary: Visible cameras fail at night and thermal sensors fail under saturation, blur or loss of contrast, yet most RGB-thermal (RGB-T) detectors mix the two streams with fixed weights and cannot tell when one modality has become unreliable. TriNetra is a reliability-aware surveillance framework built around this problem. The proposed solution computes a frame-level Thermal Reliability Coefficient (TRC) from five label-free image cues, uses it to gate the thermal features of a dual-branch YOLOv8m detector whose visible branch, neck and head are frozen and COCO-pretrained, and passes the same score to a ByteTrack-based tracker that feeds a rule-based behaviour analyser. On the M3FD benchmark (2,940/630/630 split) the detector reaches 87.6% precision, 79.4% recall, 70.0% mAP@50 and 47.8% mAP@50:95 on the test split, with 17.0 M of its 42.9 M parameters trained. TRC stays near 0.78 on clean frames (standard deviation 0.012), decreases with the severity of thermal saturation and blur, reaching 0.53 and 0.69 at full severity, and is insensitive to RGB-thermal misalignment. With identical weights, the adaptive gate matches a fixed gate on clean data (70.0% versus 69.8% mAP@50) but keeps 43.6% mAP@50 when the thermal stream is corrupted, against 38.4%, 29.2% and 25.0% for a fixed gate, full thermal admission and a closed gate; the 5.1-point gain over the fixed gate has a 95% bootstrap confidence interval of +3.6 to +6.5 points. In tracking, the TRC-gated association performs on par with ByteTrack on a synthetic benchmark with exact ground truth and on 14 M3FD clips, and is slightly less stable under thermal saturation, so its measured benefit is confined to the detector. The limitations of the current evaluation are reported together with the results.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TriNetra 监控框架：用五个免标注图像线索计算帧级「热红外可靠性系数」TRC，据此对双分支 YOLOv8m 的热特征做门控并传给 ByteTrack 与规则行为分析，在 M3FD 上验证了损坏热流时的鲁棒性，并报告跟踪端收益有限。
AI.relevance_reason: 其免监督可靠性打分与特征门控可作为「视觉证据何时不可信、何时该降权某模态」的具体方法线索，供核查是否可迁移到 LVR 的证据筛选与 LOOK 决策；但论文本身不涉及 latent 状态或推理，联系仍较间接。
